credits.title: Costanera
credits.overview: Diego is a talented but restless young trumpeter who decides to leave Rome—and his girlfriend, Alice—behind to join his mentor, Nacho, in Argentina. However, on the other side of the world, neither contracts nor certainty about the future await him, and the journey soon proves to be more existential than professional.
